purpose: End-of-support dates for PowerShell 7 releases, copied from Microsoft's PowerShell Support Lifecycle page. Get-TPPowerShellSupportStatus reads this file to warn an operator running a release that is out of support or about to be. Update the file when Microsoft publishes a new release line.
warnDaysNote: The tool's own lead time for the warning, not a Microsoft figure: an operator sees it a quarter before the date.
